title: Surge golden exercises the 🟡/🔴 warning surface only transitively — no assertion of the warning contract
evidence:
goldens/surge_basics.t1: '# t1 manifest — per-tick FNV-1a-64 state hashes (full sim state)' ... 'ticks 3000' (surge_basics is the only golden whose scenario strains nodes)

core/crisis.odin:46-58: 'if pct >= bal.health_critical_threshold_pct {' / '} else if pct >= bal.health_strain_threshold_pct {' / 'emit(state, tick, Ev_Warning_Cleared{node = t.node_id[i]})' / 'emit(state, tick, Ev_Warning_Raised{node = t.node_id[i], level = level})'

probe (replicating demos/surge_basics.dem, seed 42, 3000 ticks): raised=392 cleared=383 crisis_triggered=1 won=true lost=false levels=map[Strained=312, Critical=80]

grep Ev_Warning core/*_test.odin -> 0 hits; no demos/*.dem contains an expect for a warning event
detail: Warning events fire inside the goldened surge run and are hashed into T1, but thresholds, level values, and clear-on-recovery are asserted nowhere; a broken warning surface passes all goldens and tests.
recommended_fix: Add a crisis unit test (thresholds, levels, cleared-on-recovery) or a surge demo expect for Ev_Warning_Raised within the surge window.

title: E9 drop-ladder shed order unpinned — qos_dial golden pins stability, never the ladder
evidence:
demos/qos_dial.dem: 'at 500ms set_triage router streaming -> ok' / 'at 700ms set_priority router-house_a streaming -> ok' / 'expect hash stable' (the only QoS golden assertions)

core/flow.odin:451-455: 'if idx_in_lane > int(bal.queue_drop_depth) {' / '// per-lane queue bound: beyond the depth, packets shed' / '// newest-first (the Godot prototype's actual behavior —' / 'drop_packet(f, idx, .Queue_Overflow, &arrived)'

grep queue_drop_depth|Queue_Overflow core/*_test.odin -> 0 hits
detail: A T1 hash proves the lane behavior did not change, not that it is right: the spec'd Best→Standard→Express shed order and the newest-first depth bound have no assertion in any golden or test.
recommended_fix: Flood a dialed pipe past queue_drop_depth in a unit test and assert per-lane drop order and the newest-first convention at the depth boundary.

title: error404's 8s T2 golden is byte-identical to boot's 1s golden — the drain phase is never visualized in any golden
evidence:
sha256sum goldens/boot/01000ms.png goldens/error404/08000ms.png -> 80c1c7f3fec6ab2b4d7e0d1109609f03e8a076aac67c6950a7b38d2688be24c3 (both, identical)

error404.t1 ticks 1-50 == boot.t1 ticks 1-50 (dce792328428e870 ... 3e14cb47bcb6f5f1); data/balance.json '"grace_window_ticks": 200' + core/health.odin drain only after grace: 'if h.grace_ticks_left > 0 { h.grace_ticks_left -= 1 ... } else { severity := ... drain := clamp(severity / 10, 1, bal.meter_drain_per_tick_max) ... }'
detail: Both frames sit inside the 200-tick grace window with the meter pinned at start (identical pixels, legitimately), so the early error404 capture adds no drain visuals; only the 40s lockup (meter 0) and T1 hashes cover the drain.
recommended_fix: Add a capture inside the drain window (e.g. 30s, tick ~250-300, meter partially drained) so the loss path's telegraphed drain is golden-visible.
